boundary: Wave 4 preserves Waves 1–3 and adds 100 distinct evidence-discovery passes. seeded_with_primary means at least one relevant primary/experimental anchor was found; it does not mean the topic is saturated. gap_seeded remains a deliberate gap, not padded completion.

status_semantics.seeded_with_primary: At least one relevant primary/experimental injection-moulding evidence anchor was identified for the pass.
status_semantics.gap_seeded: The pass is preserved as an explicit gap because directly relevant primary measured evidence remains thin or indirect.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Flame-retardant compound processability
passes.objective: Consolidate measured injection-moulding evidence for flame-retardant compound processability, signals, mechanisms and bounded diagnostics.

passes.title: Wave 4 — UV stabilizer and antioxidant processing effects
passes.objective: Keep UV stabilizer and antioxidant processing effects as an explicit gap until stronger injection-moulding-specific primary measured evidence is verified.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Halogen-free flame-retardant dispersion and stability
passes.objective: Consolidate measured evidence for functional flame-retardant dispersion, rheology and thermal stability.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Conductive carbon-black CNT and graphite compounds
passes.objective: Connect conductive-filler loading and dispersion to rheology, processability and electrical performance.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Boron-nitride and thermally conductive compounds
passes.objective: Connect thermally conductive filler loading to melt flow, processing conditions and thermal performance.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Natural-fibre injection-moulded composites
passes.objective: Capture flow, moisture, fibre and mechanical-property behaviour of natural-fibre moulding compounds.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Wood-plastic injection-moulded composites
passes.objective: Capture water uptake, processing and property trade-offs in injection-moulded wood-plastic composites.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Biofilled PLA and polypropylene compounds
passes.objective: Capture injection-moulding behaviour of biofilled compounds including fibre effects and property retention.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Recycled PC-ABS composition and processability

passes.title: Wave 4 — Recycled reinforced polyamide and composite feedstocks
passes.objective: Keep recycled reinforced-polyamide feedstock behaviour as a targeted gap; current composite recycling evidence is adjacent but not sufficient.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Recycled PET contamination and intrinsic-viscosity loss

passes.title: Wave 4 — Recycled ABS-PC batch-composition control

passes.title: Wave 4 — Chemically recycled feedstock moulding quality

passes.title: Wave 4 — Recyclate VOC odour and deodorisation evidence

passes.title: Wave 4 — Masterbatch pigment dispersion and colour consistency
passes.objective: Keep masterbatch/pigment dispersion and shot-to-shot colour consistency as a targeted measured-data gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Chemical-blowing-agent rheology and residue
passes.objective: Capture chemical-blowing-agent effects on melt rheology, gas generation and process response.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Processing lubricant release-agent and plate-out mechanisms
passes.objective: Keep additive-driven release, plate-out and mould-deposit mechanisms as a primary-evidence gap distinct from surface-coating evidence.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Glass-bead versus talc shrinkage and warpage

passes.title: Wave 4 — Mineral-filler morphology and moulding response

passes.title: Wave 4 — Elastomer-modified polypropylene flow and impact balance

passes.title: Wave 4 — Venting capacity trapped-gas pressure and dieseling

passes.title: Wave 4 — Cooling-circuit fouling scale and cleaning

passes.title: Wave 4 — Coolant flow and differential-pressure diagnosis
passes.objective: Use flow and pressure-loss evidence to distinguish hydraulic cooling restrictions from temperature-setpoint issues.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Temperature-control-unit and coolant stability
passes.objective: Capture closed-loop coolant/temperature response and its effect on mould-surface stability.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Cooling-flow balance versus part quality
passes.objective: Connect coolant-flow distribution and thermal response to measured part quality.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Barrel and hot-runner heater-SSR fault signatures
passes.objective: Keep heater/SSR degradation and electrical-duty fault signatures as a targeted primary measured gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Thermocouple bias drift and thermal-zone coupling
passes.objective: Keep long-run thermocouple drift/bias and zone-coupling diagnosis as a measured evidence gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Cold-runner pressure loss and balance

passes.title: Wave 4 — Gate-freeze detection from pressure and thermal response
passes.objective: Build evidence for gate freeze/seal using cavity/process response rather than universal hold-time rules.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Gate-seal confirmation with weight and pressure plateau
passes.objective: Connect gate-freeze studies, part weight and pressure response to practical validation.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Gate shear heating erosion and vestige
passes.objective: Keep direct measured gate-shear heating, erosion progression and vestige evidence as a targeted gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Sprue and runner sticking mechanics
passes.objective: Keep sprue/runner-specific release-force and sticking evidence separate from generic part demoulding.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Mould-surface coatings and measured demould force

passes.title: Wave 4 — DLC-PVD antistiction and replication

passes.title: Wave 4 — Laser-textured mould surfaces and release friction
passes.objective: Connect engineered texture to measured release/friction behaviour.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Self-cleaning and vent-functional mould surfaces
passes.objective: Keep self-cleaning/vent-functional surface claims as an explicit gap until direct moulding evidence is verified.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Feed-throat bridging and solids starvation
passes.objective: Keep injection-machine-specific feed-throat bridging measurements as a gap; extrusion solids-conveying work is only adjacent evidence.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Hopper-loader interruption and material starvation
passes.objective: Find shot-resolved hopper/loader interruption signatures rather than relying on generic feed theory.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Dryer dew-point residence and online moisture evidence
passes.objective: Keep synchronized dryer dew point, residence and measured pellet-moisture history as a priority real-data gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Plasticising motor-current as process-state signal
passes.objective: Keep motor-current-to-melt-state interpretation as a targeted gap beyond broader energy monitoring.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Specific plasticising energy during screw recovery
passes.objective: Capture phase-specific energy as a process-state and resource-efficiency signal.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Barrel-heater degradation and zone-failure diagnosis
passes.objective: Keep heater-zone degradation/failure progression as a targeted machine-health gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Hydraulic-oil condition viscosity and contamination
passes.objective: Keep oil-condition-to-process-response evidence as a distinct gap from pump-bearing vibration diagnosis.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Hydraulic-pump efficiency and bearing-fault diagnosis
passes.objective: Capture pump bearing vibration, efficiency and energy evidence for condition-based diagnosis.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Electric servo-drive and motor condition signatures
passes.objective: Capture experimentally measured servo response and motion-quality evidence while keeping fault claims bounded.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Toggle-clamp lubrication condition monitoring
passes.objective: Use vibration signatures to distinguish lubrication degradation and reduce unnecessary maintenance.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Tie-bar and platen strain health monitoring
passes.objective: Use tie-bar strain/load evidence for clamp health and part-quality monitoring.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Online platen-parallelism and load-distribution evidence
passes.objective: Keep direct online platen-parallelism measurement as a gap distinct from indirect tie-bar load indices.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Nozzle alignment contact-force and leakage diagnosis
passes.objective: Keep direct nozzle alignment/contact-force evidence as a targeted gap beyond nozzle pressure sensing.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Check-ring closure response across melt viscosity
passes.objective: Separate non-return-valve wear/closure effects from material-viscosity effects using measured signals.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Cold-start to thermal-equilibrium stabilization

passes.title: Wave 4 — Material-change purging efficiency
passes.objective: Quantify purge performance, energy and rheology during material changeovers.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Colour-change purgeability in manifold systems
passes.objective: Use experimental colour-change tests to compare manifold purgeability and stagnation.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Barrel and hot-runner residence-time distribution
passes.objective: Keep quantified residence-time-distribution measurements as a gap beyond purge endpoints.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Screw-tip wear throughput and shot-weight stability
passes.objective: Connect actual flow/throughput degradation to screw condition without masking it with recipe compensation.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Injection-moulding predictive maintenance and RUL
passes.objective: Capture real industrial wear prediction, conditional survival and condition-based maintenance evidence.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Burn-mark and diesel-effect gas mechanisms
passes.objective: Connect trapped-gas heating and gas/process changes to quantified burn-mark severity.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Internal void versus trapped-gas bubble discrimination
passes.objective: Keep ordinary moulding void-versus-gas-bubble discrimination as a targeted primary evidence gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Moisture splay versus volatile splay discrimination
passes.objective: Use material-conditioning evidence to avoid treating all silver/splay symptoms as one mechanism.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Jetting onset and discriminating measurements

passes.title: Wave 4 — Gloss variation frozen layer and surface crystallinity

passes.title: Wave 4 — Rib-boss sink and read-through mechanisms
passes.objective: Extend measured sink/shrink evidence into thick local sections while keeping geometry-specific effects explicit.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Fibre-driven shrinkage anisotropy
passes.objective: Connect measured fibre orientation and anisotropic shrinkage/stress to warpage direction and magnitude.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Moisture-conditioned dimensional change and warpage
passes.objective: Keep post-mould moisture-conditioning dimensional drift as a targeted gap distinct from as-moulded warpage.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Delamination and interface-failure diagnosis
passes.objective: Use interface strength, processing temperature and microscopy to distinguish weak bonding mechanisms.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Gate blush and gate-region residual stress

passes.title: Wave 4 — Weld-line local temperature pressure and strength

passes.title: Wave 4 — Black-speck contamination and degradation sources

passes.title: Wave 4 — Silver-streak foaming and gas-release mechanisms
passes.objective: Keep silver-streak distinctions across moisture, volatiles, decompression and unintended foaming as a primary-evidence gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Environmental stress cracking after moulding
passes.objective: Connect moulding conditions and residual stress to experimentally measured ESC resistance.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Medical cleanroom particle and contamination control
passes.objective: Keep cleanroom particle/bioburden and moulding-contamination evidence as a distinct regulated-process gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Medical-device scientific-moulding validation and transfer

passes.title: Wave 4 — COC-COP microfluidic moulding evidence
passes.objective: Keep COC/COP-specific microfluidic replication and bonding evidence as a targeted gap beyond general microstructured polymers.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Optical-lens birefringence and residual stress
passes.objective: Use birefringence/interferometry and residual-stress measurements as direct optical quality evidence.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Injection-compression optics residual-stress reduction

passes.title: Wave 4 — Thin-wall high-speed moulding response

passes.title: Wave 4 — Micro-injection metering and shot-size accuracy
passes.objective: Use cavity pressure and screw velocity to characterize milligram-shot filling and V/P timing.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Ultrasonic micro-injection process response
passes.objective: Capture measured UMIM energy/process relationships and material-property outcomes.

passes.title: Wave 4 — In-mould electronics trace and component survival
passes.objective: Track electrical-trace deformation, thermal load and component survival across forming/moulding integration.

passes.title: Wave 4 — PCB and electrical-insert overmoulding

passes.title: Wave 4 — Polymer-metal insert bonding and preheat
passes.objective: Connect insert temperature, surface state, pressure and polymer penetration to measured bond strength.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Organosheet preheat and interface-strength control

passes.title: Wave 4 — Long-fibre orientation attrition and property transfer

passes.title: Wave 4 — LSR cure-state and flash-risk monitoring
passes.objective: Use cavity-pressure-derived cure-state evidence while keeping flash-specific claims bounded.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Thermoset cure monitoring with dielectric evidence
passes.objective: Capture in-mould cure-state evidence rather than reusing thermoplastic solidification logic.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Injection-moulding Gage R&R and measurement-system analysis
passes.objective: Keep real crossed/nested Gage R&R datasets tied to moulded dimensions and cavity identity as a high-priority gap.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Multivariate SPC with PCA PLS and Hotelling T2
passes.objective: Compare multivariate monitoring and univariate SPC on instrumented injection-moulding process data.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Full-curve and functional pressure-time analysis
passes.objective: Preserve waveform information and test when full/high-resolution time series outperform scalar summaries.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Change-point process drift and online adaptation
passes.objective: Capture industrial drift/anomaly evidence and adaptive model updating across long production sequences.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Calibrated uncertainty and conformal quality prediction
passes.objective: Keep injection-specific calibrated uncertainty and conformal prediction as an explicit gap beyond point predictions.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Out-of-distribution detection for moulding models
passes.objective: Keep direct OOD detection/abstention evidence as a gap while transfer-learning studies define domain-shift risk.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Intervention-aware causal inference versus prediction
passes.objective: Maintain a strict boundary between predictive associations, process perturbation evidence and causal root-cause claims.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Cross-machine transfer learning and domain adaptation
passes.objective: Capture data-efficiency gains and transfer limitations across parts, components and source domains.

passes.title: Wave 4 — Digital-twin calibration and model-discrepancy evidence
